notes.title: Beat 'Em Up Collection Update
notes.content:
Hello, street fighters! We have some news about the game!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649306/fe5578b0eab25106a9aa779a4ad832440ea7b2cd.jpg"]

1 - An option has been added to the settings allowing players to enable or disable the rewind feature.

2 - A written interview (in the trivia section) and over 60 images have been added to the Gourmet Sentai game gallery section.

Have fun and keep fighting!
